items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: And I had him, I got him his first job with the tuxedo.

ctx.x: Fireed him in the liquor. Well, see Paul was a downtown boy, Zutty a downtown boy. He ain't got no voice, you know what I mean? See? Well he couldn't make it, see? And I had him, I got him his first job with the tuxedo. He was a great talker, and you had to play it to his rhythm. Don't care how fast you knock off a band, you had to come down to him, see? And that's why he, and he was one of those bigger guys who always wanted to fight.
I know he messed up the Ori band sometimes on the broadcast, playing things too fast, like Muscat Ramble. Ori couldn't even play it that fast.
